# interfere_workspace (Data Source)

Look up an existing workspace without managing its lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "interfere_workspace" "team" {
  workspace_slug = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_slug` (String) Workspace URL slug, using lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

### Read-Only

- `data_residency_location` (String) Region where workspace data is stored. Set when the workspace is created.
- `id` (String) Unique workspace identifier.
- `name` (String) Display name of the workspace.
